title: Dallas Scavenger Hunt and Highlights Self Guided Walking Tour
blurb:
The Best Way to Discover Dallas: Scavenger Hunt & Self-Guided Tour. Play, learn, and walk! Explore at your own pace with a 100% self-guided activity. Start anytime (24/7) with no guides or schedules. Pause for a photo at the Thanks-Giving Square or a visit to the Dallas World Aquarium and resume whenever you're ready—even the next day. This unique team-building activity is perfect for couples, families, and groups.

The "Complete City" Package - Everything you need in one app:

Interactive Game: Solve puzzles and discover 10+ major attractions, plus hidden gems revealed along the way.

Learn the history/legends of each site.

Insider Tips: Access hand-picked local restaurant and shop recommendations.

What you will visit: Klyde Warren Park, Dallas Museum of Art, Perot Museum of Nature and Science, Dallas Aquarium, Dallas Holocaust Museum, Dealey Plaza, J.F.K Memorial Plaza, Pioneer Plaza, AT&T Discovery District, and Thanks-Giving Square.
